opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland (Carnegie Education Fund)
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: covers the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK (or asylum seekers), not eligible for government funding for tuition fees, and enrolled on or holding an unconditional offer for an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish HEI in academic year 2026-27.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering tuition fees for undergraduate students from low-income Scottish households who are ineligible for Scottish Government tuition fee support, including support for eligible second degrees in skills-shortage subject areas.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland (Carnegie Education Fund)
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households who have been accepted onto the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (delivered by Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and University of Edinburgh), ordinarily resident in Scotland, entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, and not already holding a postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: Scholarship covering full tuition fees and a £1,200 living-cost bursary for students from low-income Scottish households undertaking the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants, a partnership between Carnegie Education Fund and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh.
